extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT must be paid before applying for grant of probate
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a Guildford estate valued at £365,500 enquires about a £39,000 probate loan to pay the inheritance tax liability before applying for the grant, which is expected within about 11 weeks.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding executor funding for the Guildford estate. We have noted the estate value of £365,500 and the £39,000 requested towards the inheritance tax liability. To take this further we will need confirmation of the executors' details and identification, a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities, the HMRC inheritance tax calculation or IHT400 figures, and confirmation of any date by which the tax must be paid. Please also confirm whether any other borrowing or charges are secured against the estate property. Once we have these we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
